scope: Google/Bing SEO market research and publication control
publication_rule: Research universe is not a publishing queue. A candidate may move to approved_for_build only after market/query evidence, service or product truth, canonical ownership, useful differentiation, conversion path and measurement plan are recorded.

evidence_refs: NADA Auto Retailing State by State — 2025 annual economic activity includes number of local dealerships and share of new-vehicle registrations
candidates.evidence_boundary: State auto-retail importance is not search demand, transport capacity, or approval to publish state pages.

evidence_refs: U.S. Census County Business Patterns — establishment counts available by state, county, MSA, ZIP and detailed NAICS
candidates.evidence_boundary: Business density is a prioritization signal only; query demand and canonical intent still must be validated.

evidence_refs: SEO_LOGISTICS_MARKET_WAVE_2_2026-08-18.md — Texas first research priority based on auction footprint and dealer/fleet SERP archetype
candidates.evidence_boundary: Texas is a query-validation priority only. No Texas state, metro, dealer or auction page is approved until query demand, Hermes service truth, canonical ownership, distinct value, conversion readiness and measurement are recorded.

evidence_refs: SEO_LOGISTICS_MARKET_WAVE_2_2026-08-18.md — Florida retained as a comparison market with broad auction footprint
candidates.evidence_boundary: Auction density is a prioritization signal only and does not approve a Florida page.

evidence_refs: SEO_LOGISTICS_MARKET_WAVE_2_2026-08-18.md — California retained as a comparison market with multiple auction locations
